================================================================================
# BLOC 7 — Composition taxonomique (RRA + POO) - Phylum séparés et Confondue
================================================================================

# Ce bloc décrit la composition des communautés de macroinvertébrés par site à travers deux métriques complémentaires, à partir de physeq_sp.
#
# La RRA (Relative Read Abundance) rapporte les reads d'un taxon au total de reads du site — sensible aux biais PCR.
# Le POO (Percentage of Occurrence) normalisé calcule pour chaque taxon la proportion de réplicats PCR où il est détecté dans le site — plus robuste car un taxon vaut 1
# par PCR indépendamment de son abondance en reads.
#
# Différence avec MiFish : les visualisations sont réalisées à deux niveaux taxonomiques complémentaires — le niveau espèce pour le détail et le niveau phylum pour la vue
# d'ensemble. La diversité des quatre phylums (Arthropoda, Annelida, Mollusca, Cnidaria) justifie cette double lecture que MiFish n'avait pas, ce dernier étant focalisé sur un
# seul groupe (Teleostei).

```{r bloc6_composition, eval=run_bloc6}

library(ggupset)

# ---- Phylum-level RRA ----
tax_df_all   <- as.data.frame(tax_table(physeq_tax))
meta_tax_all <- data.frame(sample_data(physeq_tax))
otu_raw      <- as.data.frame(otu_table(physeq_tax))
if(taxa_are_rows(physeq_tax)) otu_raw <- t(otu_raw)
otu_rra_all  <- as.data.frame(t(apply(otu_raw, 1, function(x) x/sum(x)*100)))
otu_pa_all   <- as.data.frame((otu_raw > 0)*1)

rra_phy_df <- as.data.frame(sapply(phylums_cibles, function(phy) {
  cols <- rownames(tax_df_all)[tax_df_all$Phylum == phy]
  cols <- intersect(cols, colnames(otu_rra_all))
  if(length(cols) == 0) return(rep(0, nrow(otu_rra_all)))
  if(length(cols) == 1) otu_rra_all[, cols]
  else rowSums(otu_rra_all[, cols, drop=FALSE])
}))
rra_phy_df$Site <- trimws(meta_tax_all$Site)

poo_phy_df <- as.data.frame(sapply(phylums_cibles, function(phy) {
  cols <- rownames(tax_df_all)[tax_df_all$Phylum == phy]
  cols <- intersect(cols, colnames(otu_pa_all))
  if(length(cols) == 0) return(rep(0, nrow(otu_pa_all)))
  as.numeric(rowSums(otu_pa_all[, cols, drop=FALSE]) > 0)
}))
poo_phy_df$Site <- trimws(meta_tax_all$Site)

rra_phy_long <- rra_phy_df %>%
  group_by(Site) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(phylums_cibles), mean), .groups="drop") %>%
  mutate(Site=factor(trimws(Site), levels=site_order)) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-Site, names_to="Phylum", values_to="RRA") %>%
  mutate(Phylum=factor(Phylum, levels=phylums_cibles))

poo_phy_long <- poo_phy_df %>%
  group_by(Site) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(phylums_cibles), ~sum(.)/n()*100), .groups="drop") %>%
  mutate(Site=factor(trimws(Site), levels=site_order)) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-Site, names_to="Phylum", values_to="POO") %>%
  group_by(Site) %>%
  mutate(POO_norm=POO/sum(POO)*100) %>% ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Phylum=factor(Phylum, levels=phylums_cibles))

p_rra_phy <- ggplot(rra_phy_long, aes(x=Site, y=RRA, fill=Phylum)) +
  geom_bar(stat="identity", position="fill", width=0.7) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels=site_labels_court) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=phylum_colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels=scales::percent_format()) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title="Phylum composition by site — RRA",
       subtitle="COImg2 | Read proportion | 4 target Phyla",
       x=NULL, y="Read proportion", fill="Phylum") +
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=30, hjust=1, size=9),
        plot.title=element_text(face="bold", size=11))

p_poo_phy <- ggplot(poo_phy_long, aes(x=Site, y=POO_norm, fill=Phylum)) +
  geom_bar(stat="identity", position="stack", width=0.7) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels=site_labels_court) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=phylum_colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0,105), breaks=seq(0,100,25)) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title="Phylum composition by site — Normalised POO",
       subtitle="COImg2 | Relative contribution of each Phylum to detections",
       x=NULL, y="Normalised occurrence (%)", fill="Phylum") +
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=30, hjust=1, size=9),
        plot.title=element_text(face="bold", size=11),
        legend.position="bottom")

panel_phy <- (p_rra_phy | p_poo_phy) +
  plot_annotation(
    title="COImg2 — Phylum composition: RRA vs POO",
    subtitle="4 target Phyla | Same colour palette",
    theme=theme(plot.title=element_text(face="bold", size=12)))
print(panel_phy)
pdf(file.path(rep_racine, "Fig_Bloc6_COImg2_Phylum_RRA_POO.pdf"),
    width=12, height=6)
print(panel_phy)
dev.off()

# ---- Species-level RRA + POO per Phylum ----
for(phy in phylums_cibles) {
  physeq_phy <- subset_taxa(physeq_tax, Phylum==phy)
  physeq_phy <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(physeq_phy)>0, physeq_phy)
  physeq_phy <- prune_samples(sample_sums(physeq_phy)>0, physeq_phy)
  phy_spe    <- tax_glom(physeq_phy, taxrank="Species", NArm=TRUE)
  phy_spe    <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(phy_spe)>0, phy_spe)
  phy_spe    <- prune_samples(sample_sums(phy_spe)>0, phy_spe)
  n_spe      <- ntaxa(phy_spe)
  if(n_spe == 0) next

  tax_spe    <- as.data.frame(tax_table(phy_spe))
  meta_spe   <- data.frame(sample_data(phy_spe))
  spe_names  <- make.unique(tax_spe$Species)
  top_spe_n  <- min(15, n_spe)

  # RRA
  phy_rra_spe <- transform_sample_counts(phy_spe, function(x) x/sum(x)*100)
  otu_rra_spe <- as.data.frame(otu_table(phy_rra_spe))
  if(taxa_are_rows(phy_rra_spe)) otu_rra_spe <- t(otu_rra_spe)
  colnames(otu_rra_spe) <- spe_names
  otu_rra_spe$Site      <- trimws(meta_spe$Site)

  rra_long <- otu_rra_spe %>%
    group_by(Site) %>%
    summarise(across(all_of(spe_names), mean), .groups="drop") %>%
    mutate(Site=factor(trimws(Site), levels=site_order)) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(-Site, names_to="Species", values_to="RRA")

  top_spes <- rra_long %>%
    group_by(Species) %>% summarise(tot=sum(RRA), .groups="drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(tot)) %>% slice_head(n=top_spe_n) %>% pull(Species)

  rra_plot <- rra_long %>%
    mutate(Species=ifelse(Species %in% top_spes, Species, "Others")) %>%
    group_by(Site, Species) %>% summarise(RRA=sum(RRA), .groups="drop") %>%
    group_by(Site) %>% mutate(RRA_norm=RRA/sum(RRA)*100) %>% ungroup()

  spes_u <- unique(rra_plot$Species[rra_plot$Species != "Others"])
  n_pal  <- length(spes_u)
  pal_spe <- setNames(
    c(colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(min(12,max(3,n_pal)),"Paired"))(n_pal),
      "grey80"),
    c(spes_u, "Others"))

  # POO
  phy_pa_spe_sub <- transform_sample_counts(phy_spe, function(x) ifelse(x>0,1,0))
  otu_poo_spe    <- as.data.frame(otu_table(phy_pa_spe_sub))
  if(taxa_are_rows(phy_pa_spe_sub)) otu_poo_spe <- t(otu_poo_spe)
  colnames(otu_poo_spe) <- spe_names
  otu_poo_spe$Site      <- trimws(data.frame(sample_data(phy_pa_spe_sub))$Site)

  poo_plot <- otu_poo_spe %>%
    group_by(Site) %>%
    summarise(across(all_of(spe_names), ~sum(.)/n()*100), .groups="drop") %>%
    mutate(Site=factor(trimws(Site), levels=site_order)) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(-Site, names_to="Species", values_to="POO") %>%
    mutate(Species=ifelse(Species %in% top_spes, Species, "Others")) %>%
    group_by(Site, Species) %>% summarise(POO=sum(POO), .groups="drop") %>%
    group_by(Site) %>% mutate(POO_norm=POO/sum(POO)*100) %>% ungroup()

  p_rra_spe <- ggplot(rra_plot, aes(x=Site, y=RRA_norm, fill=Species)) +
    geom_bar(stat="identity", position="stack", width=0.7) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels=site_labels_court) +
    scale_fill_manual(values=pal_spe) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0,105), breaks=seq(0,100,25)) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(title=paste0(phy, " — Species (RRA)"),
         subtitle=paste0("Top ", top_spe_n, " species | Normalised RRA"),
         x=NULL, y="Normalised RRA (%)", fill="Species") +
    theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=30, hjust=1, size=8),
          legend.text=element_text(size=6.5, face="italic"),
          legend.key.size=unit(0.35,"cm"),
          plot.title=element_text(face="bold", size=10))

  p_poo_spe <- ggplot(poo_plot, aes(x=Site, y=POO_norm, fill=Species)) +
    geom_bar(stat="identity", position="stack", width=0.7) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels=site_labels_court) +
    scale_fill_manual(values=pal_spe) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0,105), breaks=seq(0,100,25)) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(title=paste0(phy, " — Species (POO)"),
         subtitle="Normalised occurrence frequency | Same palette as RRA",
         x=NULL, y="Normalised occurrence (%)", fill="Species") +
    theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=30, hjust=1, size=8),
          legend.text=element_text(size=6.5, face="italic"),
          legend.key.size=unit(0.35,"cm"),
          plot.title=element_text(face="bold", size=10))

  panel_spe <- (p_rra_spe | p_poo_spe) +
    plot_annotation(
      title=paste0("COImg2 — ", phy, " — Species composition: RRA vs POO"),
      subtitle="Same colour palette | Same top species",
      theme=theme(plot.title=element_text(face="bold", size=12),
                  plot.subtitle=element_text(size=9, color="grey40")))
  print(panel_spe)
  pdf(file.path(rep_racine,
                paste0("Fig_Bloc7_COImg2_Species_RRA_POO_", phy, ".pdf")),
      width=13, height=6)
  print(panel_spe)
  dev.off()
}

```

================================================================================
# BLOC 8 — Espèces indicatrices par site et par Phylum (IndVal.g)
#           Arthropoda | Cnidaria | Mollusca | Annelida
================================================================================

# Pour chaque espèce, multipatt combine fidélité (fréquence de détection dans les PCRs du site) et spécificité (proportion de ses détections concentrées dans ce site).
# IndVal = Fidélité × Spécificité. Seules les espèces associées à un seul site (p ≤ 0.05, 9999 permutations) sont retenues. 
# Travaille sur PCRs individuels (pas de pooling) car la fidélité nécessite la variabilité entre réplicats pour être calculée.

```{r bloc9_indval_phylum, eval=TRUE}

library(indicspecies)
library(RColorBrewer)

# ---- Objet P/A espèce ----
phy_sp_iv9 <- tax_glom(physeq_tax, taxrank="Species", NArm=TRUE)
phy_sp_iv9 <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(phy_sp_iv9)  > 0, phy_sp_iv9)
phy_sp_iv9 <- prune_samples(sample_sums(phy_sp_iv9) > 0, phy_sp_iv9)
phy_pa_iv9 <- transform_sample_counts(phy_sp_iv9, function(x) ifelse(x > 0, 1, 0))

otu_iv9  <- as.data.frame(otu_table(phy_pa_iv9))
if(taxa_are_rows(phy_pa_iv9)) otu_iv9 <- t(otu_iv9)

tax_iv9           <- as.data.frame(tax_table(phy_pa_iv9))
tax_iv9$asv_id    <- rownames(tax_iv9)

# Nom affiché : évite la répétition quand Species contient déjà le genre
# (ex. "Amphorina linaresi" au lieu de "Amphorina Amphorina linaresi")
tax_iv9$sp_label <- ifelse(
  startsWith(trimws(tax_iv9$Species), trimws(tax_iv9$Genus)),
  trimws(tax_iv9$Species),
  paste(trimws(tax_iv9$Genus), trimws(tax_iv9$Species)))

colnames(otu_iv9) <- make.unique(tax_iv9$sp_label)

meta_iv9       <- data.frame(sample_data(phy_pa_iv9))
meta_iv9$Site  <- trimws(meta_iv9$Site)
site_factor_iv9 <- factor(meta_iv9$Site, levels=site_order)

# ---- IndVal global (tous phylums) ----
set.seed(seed_global)
cat("\n=== IndVal global — tous Phylums ===\n")
indval_all <- multipatt(otu_iv9, site_factor_iv9,
                         func="IndVal.g",
                         control=how(nperm=n_perm_indval))

s_cols_all   <- grep("^s\\.", colnames(indval_all$sign), value=TRUE)
site_nms_all <- trimws(gsub("^s\\.", "", s_cols_all))

# Enrichir avec le Phylum
indval_df9 <- data.frame(
    Species = rownames(indval_all$sign),
    indval_all$sign,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  # Associer Phylum via le nom d'espèce (colname = Genus Species)
  mutate(sp_key = Species) %>%
  left_join(
    data.frame(sp_key   = colnames(otu_iv9),
               Phylum   = tax_iv9$Phylum,
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
    by = "sp_key") %>%
  filter(!is.na(p.value), p.value <= 0.05) %>%
  mutate(
    n_sites    = rowSums(across(all_of(s_cols_all))),
    Site_assoc = apply(across(all_of(s_cols_all)), 1, function(x) {
      idx <- which(x == 1)
      if(length(idx) == 0) return(NA)
      paste(site_nms_all[idx], collapse=" + ")
    })) %>%
  filter(n_sites == 1) %>%       # espèces strictement associées à 1 seul site
  mutate(
    Site_assoc = factor(trimws(Site_assoc), levels=site_order),
    Phylum     = factor(Phylum, levels=phylums_cibles),
    stat       = round(stat, 3),
    p.value    = round(p.value, 4),
    p_label    = case_when(
      p.value < 0.001 ~ paste0("p=", formatC(p.value, format="e", digits=0)),
      TRUE            ~ paste0("p=", p.value))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Phylum)) %>%      # garder seulement les 4 phylums cibles
  arrange(Phylum, Site_assoc, desc(stat))

cat("\nNb espèces indicatrices totales (p≤0.05, 1 site, 4 phylums) :",
    nrow(indval_df9), "\n")
cat("Distribution par Phylum :\n")
print(table(indval_df9$Phylum))
cat("Distribution par Site :\n")
print(table(as.character(indval_df9$Site_assoc)))

# ---- Couleurs sites ----
site_pal9 <- setNames(
  brewer.pal(max(3, length(site_order)), "Set2"),
  site_order)

# ============================================================
# FIGURE A — Panel global : 1 facette = 1 Phylum × Site
# ============================================================

if(nrow(indval_df9) > 0) {

  # Titre de facette : "Phylum | Site"
  indval_df9 <- indval_df9 %>%
    mutate(Facette = paste0(Phylum, "\n", site_labels_court[as.character(Site_assoc)]))

  n_sp_per_site_phy <- indval_df9 %>%
    group_by(Phylum, Site_assoc) %>%
    summarise(n=n(), .groups="drop")

  # Limite de largeur des étiquettes d'espèces
  indval_df9 <- indval_df9 %>%
    mutate(Species_short = ifelse(
      nchar(Species) > 30,
      paste0(substr(Species, 1, 28), "…"),
      Species))

  p_indval_global <- ggplot(
      indval_df9,
      aes(x=stat, y=reorder(Species_short, stat),
          fill=Site_assoc)) +
    geom_bar(stat="identity", width=0.72, color="white", linewidth=0.3) +
    geom_text(aes(label=p_label),
              hjust=-0.07, size=2.5, color="grey35") +
    facet_wrap(~ Phylum + Site_assoc,
               scales="free_y", ncol=4,
               labeller=labeller(
                 Phylum     = identity,
                 Site_assoc = as_labeller(site_labels_court),
                 .multi_line= TRUE)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values=site_pal9,
                      labels=site_labels_court,
                      name="Site") +
    scale_x_continuous(limits=c(0, 1.05),
                        breaks=c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1),
                        expand=expansion(mult=c(0, 0.18))) +
    theme_bw(base_size=9) +
    labs(
      title    = "Espèces indicatrices par site et par Phylum — COImg2 (IndVal.g)",
      subtitle = "Espèces associées à un unique site | p ≤ 0.05 | 4 Phylums cibles",
      x        = "IndVal",
      y        = NULL) +
    theme(
      legend.position    = "bottom",
      strip.text         = element_text(face="bold", size=8.5),
      strip.background   = element_rect(fill="grey92"),
      axis.text.y        = element_text(size=7, face="italic"),
      axis.text.x        = element_text(size=7),
      plot.title         = element_text(face="bold", size=11),
      plot.subtitle      = element_text(size=8.5, color="grey40"),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.spacing      = unit(0.5, "lines"))

  print(p_indval_global)

  # Hauteur dynamique selon le nombre de lignes
  n_rows_total  <- nrow(indval_df9)
  n_facets      <- n_distinct(paste(indval_df9$Phylum, indval_df9$Site_assoc))
  height_pdf    <- max(8, ceiling(n_rows_total / 3) * 0.35 + 3)
  width_pdf     <- 16

  pdf(file.path(rep_racine,
                "Fig_Bloc8_COImg2_IndVal_by_Phylum_by_site_global.pdf"),
      width=width_pdf, height=height_pdf)
  print(p_indval_global)
  dev.off()
  cat("--> PDF global sauvegardé\n")

} else {
  cat("Aucune espèce indicatrice trouvée — aucune figure générée.\n")
}

# ============================================================
# FIGURE B — 1 PDF par Phylum (lecture détaillée)
# ============================================================

for(phy in phylums_cibles) {

  df_phy <- indval_df9 %>% filter(Phylum == phy)
  if(nrow(df_phy) == 0) {
    cat("Phylum", phy, ": aucune espèce indicatrice — sauté\n"); next
  }

  cat("\n--- Phylum:", phy, "| Nb espèces indicatrices:", nrow(df_phy), "---\n")
  print(df_phy %>%
          select(Species, Site_assoc, stat, p.value) %>%
          arrange(Site_assoc, desc(stat)),
        row.names=FALSE)

  # Palette site limitée aux sites présents dans ce phylum
  sites_phy    <- levels(droplevels(df_phy$Site_assoc))
  pal_phy      <- site_pal9[sites_phy]

  p_phy <- ggplot(df_phy,
      aes(x=stat,
          y=reorder(Species_short, stat),
          fill=Site_assoc)) +
    geom_bar(stat="identity", width=0.72,
             color="white", linewidth=0.3) +
    geom_text(aes(label=p_label),
              hjust=-0.07, size=2.8, color="grey35") +
    facet_wrap(~Site_assoc, scales="free_y", ncol=2,
               labeller=as_labeller(site_labels_court)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values=pal_phy,
                      labels=site_labels_court[sites_phy],
                      name="Site") +
    scale_x_continuous(limits=c(0, 1.08),
                        breaks=c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1),
                        expand=expansion(mult=c(0, 0.15))) +
    theme_bw(base_size=10) +
    labs(
      title    = paste0("Espèces indicatrices — ", phy, " (IndVal.g | COImg2)"),
      subtitle = paste0("Espèces associées à un unique site | p ≤ 0.05 | ",
                         nrow(df_phy), " espèce(s)"),
      x        = "IndVal",
      y        = NULL) +
    theme(
      legend.position    = "none",
      strip.text         = element_text(face="bold", size=10,
                                         color="white"),
      strip.background   = element_rect(
        fill=phylum_colors[phy]),
      axis.text.y        = element_text(size=8, face="italic"),
      axis.text.x        = element_text(size=8),
      plot.title         = element_text(face="bold", size=11),
      plot.subtitle      = element_text(size=8.5, color="grey40"),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.spacing      = unit(0.6, "lines"))

  print(p_phy)

  height_phy <- max(5, ceiling(nrow(df_phy) / 2) * 0.45 + 3)

  pdf(file.path(rep_racine,
                paste0("Fig_Bloc8_COImg2_IndVal_", phy, "_by_site.pdf")),
      width=11, height=height_phy)
  print(p_phy)
  dev.off()
  cat("--> PDF sauvegardé :", paste0("Fig_Bloc9_COImg2_IndVal_", phy, "_by_site.pdf\n"))
}

cat("\n=== FIN BLOC 8 — IndVal par site et par Phylum ===\n")

```

================================================================================
# BLOC 9 - Tests de Mantel (distance-decay)
================================================================================

# Ce bloc teste si la dissimilarité des communautés de macroinvertébrés entre sites augmente avec la distance géographique.
# Patron de distance-decay attendu le long d'un gradient estuarien.
#
# Même logique que MiFish : matrice site × espèce P/A poolée par max (depuis physeq_tax), dissimilarité de Sørensen corrélée à la distance géographique absolue en km via le
# test de Mantel (Pearson, 9999 permutations).
#
# Figure 1 : global avec vs sans Lyvet — les paires impliquant Lyvet sont colorées différemment pour visualiser l'influence du site d'eau douce sur le patron de distance-decay.
# Figure 2 : global sans Lyvet + par capsule sur le même graphique — 10 paires de sites par capsule.

```{r bloc8_mantel, eval=run_bloc8}

library(indicspecies)

if(!exists("mat_sp_nl")) {
  physeq_tax_nl <- prune_samples(
    sample_data(physeq_tax)$Site != "Lyvet", physeq_tax)
  physeq_tax_nl <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(physeq_tax_nl)>0, physeq_tax_nl)
  mat_sp_nl <- prep_betapart_matrix(physeq_tax_nl)
}
mat_sp <- prep_betapart_matrix(physeq_tax)

run_mantel <- function(mat_pa, label) {
  sites_p  <- intersect(site_order, rownames(mat_pa))
  dist_geo <- as.dist(outer(
    meta_sites$Distance[match(sites_p, meta_sites$Site)],
    meta_sites$Distance[match(sites_p, meta_sites$Site)],
    function(a,b) abs(a-b)))
  dist_eco <- vegdist(mat_pa[sites_p,], method="bray", binary=TRUE)
  cat("\n=== Mantel —", label, "===\n")
  set.seed(seed_global)
  mtest <- mantel(dist_eco, dist_geo, method="pearson",
                  permutations=n_perm_mantel)
  print(mtest)
  data.frame(label=label, r_mantel=round(mtest$statistic,3),
             p_value=round(mtest$signif,4))
}

mantel_full <- run_mantel(mat_sp,    "Global — with Lyvet")
mantel_nl   <- run_mantel(mat_sp_nl, "Global — without Lyvet")

# ---- Figure 1: 2 regression lines — WITH Lyvet vs WITHOUT Lyvet ----
sites_full  <- rownames(mat_sp)
dist_sp_geo <- outer(meta_sites$Distance, meta_sites$Distance,
                      function(a,b) abs(a-b))
dist_sp_eco <- as.matrix(vegdist(mat_sp, method="bray", binary=TRUE))

# Dataset WITH Lyvet — toutes les paires
pairs_with <- data.frame(
  dist_geo = dist_sp_geo[lower.tri(dist_sp_geo)],
  dist_eco = dist_sp_eco[lower.tri(dist_sp_eco)],
  Courbe   = "With Lyvet")

# Dataset WITHOUT Lyvet
sites_nl_fig1  <- rownames(mat_sp_nl)
dist_geo_nl1   <- outer(
  meta_sites$Distance[match(sites_nl_fig1, meta_sites$Site)],
  meta_sites$Distance[match(sites_nl_fig1, meta_sites$Site)],
  function(a,b) abs(a-b))
dist_eco_nl1   <- as.matrix(vegdist(mat_sp_nl, method="bray", binary=TRUE))
pairs_without  <- data.frame(
  dist_geo = dist_geo_nl1[lower.tri(dist_geo_nl1)],
  dist_eco = dist_eco_nl1[lower.tri(dist_eco_nl1)],
  Courbe   = "Without Lyvet")

pairs_fig1_both <- rbind(pairs_with, pairs_without) %>%
  mutate(Courbe = factor(Courbe, levels = c("With Lyvet", "Without Lyvet")))

colors_fig1 <- c("With Lyvet"    = "#333333",
                  "Without Lyvet" = "#1f78b4")

label_with    <- paste0("r = ", mantel_full$r_mantel, "  /  p ", mantel_full$p_value)
label_without <- paste0("r = ", mantel_nl$r_mantel,   "  /  p ", mantel_nl$p_value)

p_fig1_mantel <- ggplot(pairs_fig1_both,
    aes(x = dist_geo, y = dist_eco, color = Courbe, fill = Courbe)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.0, alpha = 0.40) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, linewidth = 1.4, alpha = 0.15) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = colors_fig1,
    name   = NULL,
    labels = c(
      "With Lyvet"    = paste0("With Lyvet       ", label_with),
      "Without Lyvet" = paste0("Without Lyvet  ", label_without))) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = colors_fig1,
    name   = NULL,
    labels = c(
      "With Lyvet"    = paste0("With Lyvet       ", label_with),
      "Without Lyvet" = paste0("Without Lyvet  ", label_without))) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.05)) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  labs(title    = "1 — Distance-decay: with vs without Lyvet",
       subtitle = "Sørensen P/A | Species level | COImg2 | 95% CI",
       x = "Geographic distance (km)",
       y = "Dissimilarity (Sørensen)") +
  theme(plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
        plot.subtitle    = element_text(size = 8, color = "grey40"),
        legend.position  = "bottom",
        legend.text      = element_text(size = 9),
        legend.key.width = unit(1.5, "cm"))

# ---- Figure 2: 3 capsules only WITHOUT Lyvet ----
build_mat_cap <- function(physeq_obj, capsule_name) {
  phy_pa  <- transform_sample_counts(physeq_obj, function(x) ifelse(x>0,1,0))
  otu_mat <- as.data.frame(otu_table(phy_pa))
  if(taxa_are_rows(phy_pa)) otu_mat <- t(otu_mat)
  meta_dd         <- data.frame(sample_data(phy_pa))
  otu_mat$Site    <- trimws(meta_dd$Site)
  otu_mat$Capsule <- meta_dd$Capsule
  mat <- otu_mat %>%
    filter(Capsule==capsule_name, Site!="Lyvet") %>%
    select(-Capsule) %>%
    group_by(Site) %>%
    summarise(across(where(is.numeric), max), .groups="drop") %>%
    as.data.frame()
  rownames(mat) <- mat$Site; mat$Site <- NULL
  sites_ok <- intersect(site_order, rownames(mat))
  mat <- mat[sites_ok, colSums(mat[sites_ok,])>0, drop=FALSE]
  if(nrow(mat) < 3) return(NULL)
  mat
}

get_pairs_cap <- function(mat_cap, capsule_name) {
  sites_c  <- rownames(mat_cap)
  dists    <- meta_sites$Distance[match(sites_c, meta_sites$Site)]
  dist_geo <- as.dist(outer(dists, dists, function(a,b) abs(a-b)))
  dist_eco <- vegdist(mat_cap, method="bray", binary=TRUE)
  set.seed(seed_global)
  mt <- mantel(dist_eco, dist_geo, method="pearson",
               permutations=n_perm_mantel)
  cat("\nMantel", capsule_name, "without Lyvet: r=",
      round(mt$statistic,3), "p=", round(mt$signif,4), "\n")
  geo_mat <- as.matrix(dist_geo)
  eco_mat <- as.matrix(dist_eco)
  data.frame(dist_geo=geo_mat[lower.tri(geo_mat)],
             dist_eco=eco_mat[lower.tri(eco_mat)],
             Capsule=capsule_name,
             r_mantel=round(mt$statistic,3),
             p_mantel=round(mt$signif,4))
}

# Per capsule pairs (3 capsules, no Global)
all_cap_pairs <- do.call(rbind, lapply(capsules_principales, function(cap) {
  mat_cap <- build_mat_cap(physeq_sp, cap)
  if(is.null(mat_cap)) return(NULL)
  tryCatch(get_pairs_cap(mat_cap, cap), error=function(e) NULL)
}))

pairs_fig2 <- all_cap_pairs %>%
  mutate(Capsule = factor(Capsule, levels = capsules_principales))

colors_fig2 <- c("Waterra"  = "#e41a1c",
                  "Venturi"  = "#377eb8",
                  "TorpeDNA" = "#4daf4a")

mantel_labels_caps <- pairs_fig2 %>%
  distinct(Capsule, r_mantel, p_mantel) %>%
  mutate(lab = paste0(Capsule, ": r=", r_mantel, " / p=", p_mantel)) %>%
  pull(lab) %>% paste(collapse="\n")

p_fig2_mantel <- ggplot(pairs_fig2,
    aes(x=dist_geo, y=dist_eco, color=Capsule, fill=Capsule)) +
  geom_point(size=2.2, alpha=0.60) +
  geom_smooth(method="lm", se=TRUE, linewidth=1.2, alpha=0.12) +
  scale_color_manual(values=colors_fig2, name="Capsule") +
  scale_fill_manual(values=colors_fig2,  name="Capsule") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0, 1.05)) +
  theme_bw(base_size=11) +
  labs(title    = "2 — Distance-decay: per capsule (without Lyvet)",
       subtitle = mantel_labels_caps,
       x="Geographic distance (km)", y="Dissimilarity (Sørensen)") +
  theme(plot.title     = element_text(face="bold", size=11),
        plot.subtitle  = element_text(size=8, color="grey40"),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.text     = element_text(size=9))

# ---- Assemblage unique des 2 graphiques ----
fig_mantel_final <- (p_fig1_mantel | p_fig2_mantel) +
  plot_annotation(
    title    = "Distance-decay — Mantel tests (COImg2 | Sørensen P/A | Species level)",
    subtitle = "Left: global with vs without Lyvet | Right: per capsule without Lyvet (95% CI)",
    theme    = theme(
      plot.title      = element_text(face="bold", size=13),
      plot.subtitle   = element_text(size=9, color="grey40"),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill="white", color=NA)))

print(fig_mantel_final)

pdf(file.path(rep_racine, "Fig_Bloc9_COImg2_Distance_decay_2panels.pdf"),
    width=14, height=6)
print(fig_mantel_final)
dev.off()

build_mat_cap_phy <- function(physeq_obj, capsule_name, phylum_name) {
  tax_df  <- as.data.frame(tax_table(physeq_obj))
  taxa_ok <- rownames(tax_df)[!is.na(tax_df$Phylum) &
                                tax_df$Phylum == phylum_name]
  if(length(taxa_ok) == 0) return(NULL)

  phy_sub <- prune_taxa(taxa_ok, physeq_obj)
  phy_sub <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(phy_sub) > 0, phy_sub)
  if(ntaxa(phy_sub) == 0) return(NULL)

  phy_pa  <- transform_sample_counts(phy_sub, function(x) ifelse(x > 0, 1, 0))
  otu_mat <- as.data.frame(otu_table(phy_pa))
  if(taxa_are_rows(phy_pa)) otu_mat <- t(otu_mat)

  meta_dd         <- data.frame(sample_data(phy_pa))
  otu_mat$Site    <- trimws(meta_dd$Site)
  otu_mat$Capsule <- meta_dd$Capsule

  mat <- otu_mat %>%
    filter(Capsule == capsule_name, Site != "Lyvet") %>%
    select(-Capsule) %>%
    group_by(Site) %>%
    summarise(across(where(is.numeric), max), .groups="drop") %>%
    as.data.frame()
  rownames(mat) <- mat$Site; mat$Site <- NULL

  sites_ok <- intersect(site_order, rownames(mat))
  mat <- mat[sites_ok, colSums(mat[sites_ok, , drop=FALSE]) > 0, drop=FALSE]
  if(nrow(mat) < 3) return(NULL)
  mat
}

# ---- Fonction : paires dissimilarite + Mantel pour 1 capsule x 1 phylum ----
get_pairs_cap_phy <- function(mat_cap, capsule_name) {
  sites_c  <- rownames(mat_cap)
  dists    <- meta_sites$Distance[match(sites_c, meta_sites$Site)]
  dist_geo <- as.dist(outer(dists, dists, function(a, b) abs(a - b)))
  dist_eco <- vegdist(mat_cap, method="bray", binary=TRUE)

  mt_r <- NA_real_; mt_p <- NA_real_
  if(length(dist_geo) >= 3) {
    set.seed(seed_global)
    mt <- tryCatch(
      mantel(dist_eco, dist_geo, method="pearson",
             permutations=n_perm_mantel),
      error=function(e) NULL)
    if(!is.null(mt)) {
      mt_r <- round(mt$statistic, 3)
      mt_p <- round(mt$signif, 4)
    }
  }

  geo_mat <- as.matrix(dist_geo)
  eco_mat <- as.matrix(dist_eco)
  data.frame(
    dist_geo = geo_mat[lower.tri(geo_mat)],
    dist_eco = eco_mat[lower.tri(eco_mat)],
    Capsule  = capsule_name,
    r_mantel = mt_r,
    p_mantel = mt_p,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

# ---- Construction des paires pour les 4 phylums x 3 capsules ----
cat("\n=== Distance-decay par Phylum x Capsule (sans Lyvet) ===\n")

all_pairs_phy <- do.call(rbind, lapply(phylums_cibles, function(phy) {
  pairs_phy <- do.call(rbind, lapply(capsules_principales, function(cap) {
    mat_cap <- build_mat_cap_phy(physeq_tax, cap, phy)
    if(is.null(mat_cap)) {
      cat("  ", phy, "|", cap, ": < 3 sites — ignore\n")
      return(NULL)
    }
    df <- tryCatch(get_pairs_cap_phy(mat_cap, cap), error=function(e) NULL)
    if(!is.null(df))
      cat("  ", phy, "|", cap,
          ": n_sites=", nrow(mat_cap),
          "| r=", df$r_mantel[1], "| p=", df$p_mantel[1], "\n")
    df
  }))
  if(is.null(pairs_phy) || nrow(pairs_phy) == 0) return(NULL)
  pairs_phy$Phylum <- phy
  pairs_phy
}))

if(is.null(all_pairs_phy) || nrow(all_pairs_phy) == 0) {
  cat("Aucune donnee disponible pour le distance-decay par phylum.\n")
} else {

  all_pairs_phy <- all_pairs_phy %>%
    mutate(
      Phylum  = factor(Phylum,  levels=phylums_cibles),
      Capsule = factor(Capsule, levels=capsules_principales))

  # ---- Etiquette Mantel par capsule x phylum (subtitle de chaque panneau) ----
  mantel_lab_df <- all_pairs_phy %>%
    distinct(Phylum, Capsule, r_mantel, p_mantel) %>%
    mutate(
      p_fmt = case_when(
        is.na(p_mantel)  ~ "NA",
        p_mantel < 0.001 ~ paste0("p=", formatC(p_mantel, format="e", digits=0)),
        TRUE             ~ paste0("p=", p_mantel)),
      mantel_str = paste0(Capsule, ": r=", r_mantel, " ", p_fmt)) %>%
    group_by(Phylum) %>%
    summarise(mantel_label = paste(mantel_str, collapse="  |  "),
              .groups="drop")

  # ---- 1 ggplot par phylum ----
  plots_dd_phy <- lapply(phylums_cibles, function(phy) {

    df_phy <- all_pairs_phy %>% filter(Phylum == phy)
    if(nrow(df_phy) == 0) return(
      ggplot() +
        annotate("text", x=0.5, y=0.5,
                 label=paste0(phy, "\nAucune donnee"),
                 size=4, color="grey50") +
        theme_void() + labs(title=phy))

    lab_sub    <- mantel_lab_df$mantel_label[mantel_lab_df$Phylum == phy]
    if(length(lab_sub) == 0) lab_sub <- ""
    caps_dispo <- levels(droplevels(df_phy$Capsule))
    col_dispo  <- capsule_colors[caps_dispo]

    ggplot(df_phy,
           aes(x=dist_geo, y=dist_eco, color=Capsule, fill=Capsule)) +
      geom_point(size=2.2, alpha=0.65,
                 position=position_jitter(width=0.05, height=0,
                                          seed=seed_global)) +
      geom_smooth(method="lm", se=TRUE, linewidth=1.0, alpha=0.15) +
      scale_color_manual(values=col_dispo, name="Capsule", drop=FALSE) +
      scale_fill_manual(values=col_dispo,  name="Capsule", drop=FALSE) +
      scale_x_continuous(name="Distance geographique (km)") +
      scale_y_continuous(name="Dissimilarite (Sorensen)",
                         limits=c(0, 1.05)) +
      theme_bw(base_size=10) +
      labs(title=phy, subtitle=lab_sub) +
      theme(
        plot.title      = element_text(face="bold", size=11,
                                        color=phylum_colors[phy]),
        plot.subtitle   = element_text(size=6.8, color="grey40",
                                       lineheight=0.95),
        legend.position = "none",
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
  })
  names(plots_dd_phy) <- phylums_cibles

  # ---- Legende capsule partagee ----
  leg_dd <- cowplot::get_legend(
    ggplot(
      data.frame(
        Capsule = factor(capsules_principales, levels=capsules_principales),
        x=seq_along(capsules_principales), y=1),
      aes(x=x, y=y, color=Capsule, fill=Capsule)) +
      geom_point(size=3) +
      geom_smooth(method="lm", se=TRUE, alpha=0.2, linewidth=1) +
      scale_color_manual(values=capsule_colors[capsules_principales],
                         name="Capsule") +
      scale_fill_manual(values=capsule_colors[capsules_principales],
                        name="Capsule") +
      guides(color=guide_legend(
        title.position="top", direction="horizontal", nrow=1,
        override.aes=list(
          size=3, linewidth=1,
          fill=unname(capsule_colors[capsules_principales])))) +
      theme(legend.position  = "bottom",
            legend.text      = element_text(size=10),
            legend.title     = element_text(size=10, face="bold")))

  # ---- Assemblage 2 x 2 + legende ----
  panel_dd_phy <- wrap_plots(plots_dd_phy, ncol=2) +
    plot_annotation(
      title    = "Distance-decay par Phylum - COImg2 | Sorensen P/A | sans Lyvet",
      subtitle = "3 capsules par panneau (Waterra | Venturi | TorpeDNA) | Regression lineaire + IC 95%",
      theme    = theme(
        plot.title    = element_text(face="bold", size=12),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size=9, color="grey40")))

  fig_dd_phy <- cowplot::plot_grid(
    panel_dd_phy,
    leg_dd,
    ncol=1,
    rel_heights=c(0.91, 0.09))

  print(fig_dd_phy)

  pdf(file.path(rep_racine,
                "Fig_Bloc9_COImg2_Distance_decay_by_Phylum_4panels.pdf"),
      width=12, height=10)
  print(fig_dd_phy)
  dev.off()

  cat("\n--> PDF sauvegarde : Fig_Bloc9_COImg2_Distance_decay_by_Phylum_4panels.pdf\n")
}
```

================================================================================
# BLOC 10 — Partition β-diversité (betapart, Sørensen)
================================================================================

# Ce bloc analyse les mécanismes écologiques sous-jacents à la variation de composition entre sites le long du gradient pour les macroinvertébrés.
#
# Même logique que MiFish : tous les PCRs sont agrégés par site (max de présence) pour obtenir une matrice site × espèce en présence/absence puis beta.multi calcule les
# indices globaux de Sørensen (Bsor = Bsim + Bnes) et beta.pair les indices pairwise pour les heatmaps.
# Le test de Wilcoxon apparié unilatéral (H1 : Bsim > Bnes) teste si le turnover domine le nestedness.
#
# Différence avec MiFish : la matrice est construite depuis physeq_tax_nl (niveau ASV brut filtré sur les phylums cibles) et non depuis physeq_sp directement — cela garantit
# que l'information de phylum est correctement préservée pour l'ensemble des analyses betapart. Le résultat alimente le Tableau 1 (colonne COI Invertebrates) et les Fig. Supp. 5.
#
# Toutes les analyses sont répétées : global sans Lyvet et par capsule séparément (sans Lyvet) → Tableau 1.

```{r bloc7_betapart, eval=run_bloc7}

library(betapart)

# Global without Lyvet
physeq_tax_nl <- prune_samples(
  sample_data(physeq_tax)$Site != "Lyvet", physeq_tax)
physeq_tax_nl <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(physeq_tax_nl)>0, physeq_tax_nl)

mat_sp_nl <- prep_betapart_matrix(physeq_tax_nl)
beta_nl   <- beta.multi(mat_sp_nl, index.family="sorensen")

cat("\n=== Global beta-diversity partition — WITHOUT Lyvet ===\n")
data.frame(
  Bsor     = round(beta_nl$beta.SOR, 3),
  Bsim     = round(beta_nl$beta.SIM, 3),
  Bnes     = round(beta_nl$beta.SNE, 3),
  Pct_turn = round(beta_nl$beta.SIM/beta_nl$beta.SOR*100, 1)) %>% print()

beta_pair_nl <- beta.pair(mat_sp_nl, index.family="sorensen")

# Wilcoxon global sans Lyvet
bsim_nl_v    <- as.vector(as.dist(beta_pair_nl$beta.sim))
bsne_nl_v    <- as.vector(as.dist(beta_pair_nl$beta.sne))
tw_global_nl <- wilcox.test(bsim_nl_v, bsne_nl_v,
                             paired=TRUE, alternative="greater")
cat("\n=== Wilcoxon Turnover > Nestedness — Global — WITHOUT Lyvet ===\n")
cat("p =", round(tw_global_nl$p.value, 4), "\n")

p_b1 <- plot_beta_heatmap(beta_pair_nl$beta.sor,
  "Total dissimilarity (Bsor) — without Lyvet", "#252525")
p_b2 <- plot_beta_heatmap(beta_pair_nl$beta.sim,
  "Turnover (Bsim) — without Lyvet", "#7f0000")
p_b3 <- plot_beta_heatmap(beta_pair_nl$beta.sne,
  "Nestedness (Bnes) — without Lyvet", "#00441b")

panel_beta_global <- (p_b1 | p_b2 | p_b3) +
  plot_annotation(
    title    = "COImg2 — Beta-diversity partition — Without Lyvet",
    subtitle = "Bsor = Bsim + Bnes | Sørensen | Species level",
    theme    = theme(plot.title=element_text(face="bold", size=12)))
print(panel_beta_global)
pdf(file.path(rep_racine, "Fig_Bloc7_COImg2_Betapart_Global_without_Lyvet.pdf"),
    width=14, height=5)
print(panel_beta_global)
dev.off()

# ---- Per capsule WITHOUT Lyvet ----
cat("\n=== Betapart per capsule — WITHOUT Lyvet ===\n")

recap_bp_cap <- do.call(rbind, lapply(capsules_principales, function(cap) {
  phy_cap <- prune_samples(
    sample_data(physeq_tax_nl)$Capsule == cap, physeq_tax_nl)
  phy_cap <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(phy_cap)>0, phy_cap)
  phy_cap <- prune_samples(sample_sums(phy_cap)>0, phy_cap)
  if(nsamples(phy_cap) < 4) return(NULL)

  mat <- tryCatch(prep_betapart_matrix(phy_cap), error=function(e) NULL)
  if(is.null(mat) || nrow(mat) < 3) return(NULL)

  bm <- tryCatch(beta.multi(mat, index.family="sorensen"), error=function(e) NULL)
  if(is.null(bm)) return(NULL)

  bp <- tryCatch(beta.pair(mat, index.family="sorensen"), error=function(e) NULL)

  # Wilcoxon turnover vs nestedness
  if(!is.null(bp)) {
    tw <- tryCatch(
      wilcox.test(as.vector(as.dist(bp$beta.sim)),
                  as.vector(as.dist(bp$beta.sne)),
                  paired=TRUE, alternative="greater"),
      error=function(e) NULL)
    p_wilcox <- if(!is.null(tw)) round(tw$p.value, 4) else NA
  } else { p_wilcox <- NA }

  cat("\nCapsule:", cap, "\n")
  cat("  Bsor=", round(bm$beta.SOR,3), "Bsim=", round(bm$beta.SIM,3),
      "Bnes=", round(bm$beta.SNE,3),
      "| %Turn=", round(bm$beta.SIM/bm$beta.SOR*100,1),
      "| Wilcoxon p=", p_wilcox, "\n")

  # Heatmaps per capsule
  if(!is.null(bp)) {
    ph_sim <- plot_beta_heatmap(bp$beta.sim,
      paste0("Turnover (Bsim) — ", cap, " — without Lyvet"), "#7f0000")
    ph_sne <- plot_beta_heatmap(bp$beta.sne,
      paste0("Nestedness (Bnes) — ", cap, " — without Lyvet"), "#00441b")
    panel_cap <- (ph_sim | ph_sne) +
      plot_annotation(
        title    = paste0("COImg2 — Beta-diversity partition — ", cap, " — Without Lyvet"),
        subtitle = paste0("Bsor=", round(bm$beta.SOR,3),
                           " | Bsim=", round(bm$beta.SIM,3),
                           " | Bnes=", round(bm$beta.SNE,3),
                           " | %Turnover=", round(bm$beta.SIM/bm$beta.SOR*100,1), "%"),
        theme=theme(plot.title=element_text(face="bold", size=11),
                    plot.subtitle=element_text(size=9, color="grey40")))
    print(panel_cap)
    pdf(file.path(rep_racine,
                  paste0("Fig_Bloc10_COImg2_Betapart_", cap, "_without_Lyvet.pdf")),
        width=10, height=5)
    print(panel_cap)
    dev.off()

    # --- PDF séparés : Turnover seul ---
    pdf(file.path(rep_racine,
                  paste0("Fig_Bloc10_COImg2_Betapart_", cap, "_Turnover_without_Lyvet.pdf")),
        width=6, height=5)
    print(ph_sim)
    dev.off()

    # --- PDF séparés : Nestedness seul ---
    pdf(file.path(rep_racine,
                  paste0("Fig_Bloc10_COImg2_Betapart_", cap, "_Nestedness_without_Lyvet.pdf")),
        width=6, height=5)
    print(ph_sne)
    dev.off()

    cat("  --> PDFs Turnover et Nestedness exportés séparément pour", cap, "\n")
  }

  data.frame(Capsule=cap, n_sites=nrow(mat),
             Bsor=round(bm$beta.SOR,3), Bsim=round(bm$beta.SIM,3),
             Bnes=round(bm$beta.SNE,3),
             Pct_turn=round(bm$beta.SIM/bm$beta.SOR*100,1),
             Wilcoxon_p=p_wilcox)
}))

cat("\n=== Betapart summary per capsule — without Lyvet ===\n")
print(recap_bp_cap, row.names=FALSE)
```
